'''Sskal''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] who lived during the early years of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. He lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Byrsym]], where he worked as the bodyguard of the [[Toydarian/Legends|Toydarian]] merchant [[Ballon]]. He was present with Ballon in the bar [[Emthuul's]] when a group of [[Agent/Legends|agents]] from the planet [[Daimar]] attempted to contact Ballon.

==Personality andf traits==
Sskal was not very intelligent, but he was tough and was devoted to serving Ballon.
